result.description: Meta Marketing API: create, manage and report on Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns, audiences, creatives and insights via the Graph API.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 via Facebook Login dialog (scope ads_management / ads_read) gives user access tokens. System user tokens are used for server-to-server access. The ads MCP server also accepts a pre-obtained access token.
result.access_detail: Anyone can create a Meta app free and get Limited access (the default) for their own ad accounts. To manage other people's ad accounts, the app needs advanced access to ads_read / ads_management, which Meta approves through App Review per permission. Business Verification applies if the app accesses sensitive data. Full access tier also needs 500+ API calls in 15 days with an error rate under 15%.
result.api_notes: Marketing API sits on the Graph API (REST-style, versioned). It covers campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, custom audiences, insights/reporting, ad accounts and catalogs. Official SDKs exist but are not mentioned on the pages I fetched.
result.blocker: Serving other users' ad accounts needs App Review for advanced access to ads_read / ads_management, plus Business Verification where sensitive data is involved. Meta's official MCP tool access is rolling out gradually.

evidence.quote: If you're managing someone's ads, use the `scope` parameter to prompt them for the `ads_management` or `ads_read` permissions.
Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis.
If your app is managing other people's ad accounts, you need advanced access to the `ads_read` and/or `ads_management` permissions.
Business apps are subject to an additional layer of Graph API authorization called access levels.
Today, we are opening up our ads MCP server to any developer with their own Meta app.
we'll be gradually rolling out access to tools available to ad accounts through this integration method.
